names.name: CopyProtection__Is_Launcher_Running
names.evidence: Its debug messages are "COPYPROTECTION - Checking if launcher is running" and "result was %d"; it uses the name 48BC11BD-C4D7-466b-8A31-C6ABBAD47B3E. One caller. The Steam and EA App exes overwrite its first bytes with mov al, 1; ret (docs/RECON.md); the retail 1.001 exe keeps the body.

names.name: CopyProtection__Notify_Launcher
names.evidence: Its debug messages are "COPYPROTECTION - Notify launcher", "Launcher notified.", "Waiting for message from launcher." and "***** Failed to notify launcher!"; it uses the name D6E7FC97-64F9-4d28-B52C-754EDF721C6F. Three callers.

names.name: Init__Boot_Screen
names.evidence: Pushes "GLSMD.PAL" first (0x005312AA) and uses GLSSMD.SHP, GLSLMD.SHP, TXT_COPYRIGHT and GUI:WWBrand; an assert names Init.CPP. It is the call at 0x0052C5F3 that run_lift.py's yr_startup_order_patches moves, and moving it moves the loading picture with the copyright line.

names.name: Movie__Play_Movie
names.evidence: Prints "Play_Movie() as Bink!" (0x005BEDA8) and "Stretching movie %dx%d -> %dx%d" (0x005BF026) and uses the extension ".bik" (0x005BED92). 34 callers; the call at 0x0052C5EE passes "EA_WWLOGO" (0x00825F20) and the logo plays. 0x005C07D0 prints the same first message without the stretch and stays unnamed.

names.name: Math__ftol
names.evidence: Bytes: fnstcw [esp]; cmp the control word with [0x00822D80]; when they differ, fldcw [0x00822D80] and leave it loaded; fistp qword; return edx:eax. The float-to-integer helper the compiler calls, with the game's own control word in place of a save and restore. 1624 direct callers.

names.name: CRT__chkstk
names.evidence: Bytes: push ecx; cmp eax, 0x1000; lea ecx, [esp + 8]; then sub ecx, 0x1000 / test [ecx], eax a page at a time; last, mov esp, ecx and return through the saved return address. MSVC 6's stack probe (_chkstk, also __alloca_probe): eax is the frame size. 39 direct callers.
